meta.title: Cezeri: Wheels of Time
meta.description: Cezeri: Wheels of Time — an original DEMO wheel game. Winning slices clamp in place, four brass wheels turn again, and the hub multiplier rises by 1 every spin; in the Elephant Clock the hub is kept and the automaton falcon drops wild gears.

settings.demoText: Balance {balance}{remote, select, yes { (server)} other {}}. Refilling sets the balance to {start} DEMO and adds a “Balance refilled” row to the history; it is not possible while a round or autoplay is running.

steps.bet: Choose your bet. The − and + buttons change the bet by one step; tap the bet amount to open every step. “Max bet” picks the highest step your balance allows.
steps.spin: Spin. Press the winding-crank button or use the space bar. The round cost ({factor} times the bet when Chance ×2 is on) is deducted from the balance once.
steps.wheels: The wheels. The board is a hub with 4 concentric rings around it; each ring has 12 slices and turns on its own track. 12 spokes run outward from the hub.
steps.spokes: Spoke wins. 3 or 4 consecutive slices of the same symbol on a spoke pay if they start at ring 1 or ring 2. The 12 spokes pay separately. The win is multiplied by the hub multiplier of that spin.
steps.lock: Gear Lock. If there is a new win, the winning slices clamp in place, the four rings spin again beneath them, and the hub rises by +1. This goes on until no new pay arrives (up to {max} respins).
steps.result: The result. The whole round is determined by the engine before the spin starts; the animation only plays that result. The spin button stays locked until the round (every respin and free spin) has finished; use the Quick/Turbo setting to speed it up. The speed setting, tapping the celebration counter, a hidden tab or leaving the page does not change the payout; the round always closes once, with the engine's payout.

how.note: DEMO credit has no value; it does not earn SOL, tokens or rewards. The game runs in the browser with local randomness; there is no VRF proof.

pay.lead: On a spoke, 3 or 4 consecutive slices of the same symbol, from the inside out, pay. The large figure is the gross DEMO amount per spoke at a bet of {bet} (hub ×1); the multiplier beneath it is a multiple of the bet. The hub multiplier multiplies this amount.
pay.gearText: Stands in for every symbol except the Water Vessel. A run made only of gears pays from its own table; the higher-paying reading of the run counts.
pay.scatterText: Counted anywhere on the rings of the spin's final board; not multiplied by the hub. In the base game {vessels}+ vessels trigger {spins} free spins.
pay.maxText: At this bet: {amount}. If the round total reaches this cap, the round ends immediately; the remaining free spins are not played.

hub.title: Hub multiplier
hub.text: Every spin begins with the hub being drawn; the hub multiplies all spoke wins of that spin. Draw probabilities in the base game:

lock.title: Gear Lock (respin chain)
lock.text: If a spin has a new pay, the slices of the winning runs lock; they keep their symbols and do not move. Then all four rings spin again beneath the locked slices, and the hub rises by +1 with every respin. If a locked run grows (3 → 4 slices), only the difference is paid. The chain ends on the first spin without a new pay, when all 48 slices are locked, or after {max} respins (the last spin is still paid). In the base game the respins spin on strips with one Golden Gear per ring.

elephant.title: Elephant Clock ({spins} free spins)
elephant.text: In the base game {trigger} or more Water Vessels trigger {spins} free spins. The hub multiplier is not reset between free spins: each spin starts from the hub where the previous spin ended or the larger of its own draw, and respins add +1; the hub only rises. In a free spin, {retriggerVessels}+ vessels add {retrigger} more spins (no pay). At most {max} free spins are awarded in a round.

falcon.title: Water reservoir and automaton falcon
falcon.text: After every free spin the reservoir fills one step. At step {levels} it drains and, if spins remain, the automaton falcon drops {counts} Golden Gear wild slices onto one ring. These wilds stay in place until the feature ends and can complete wins on every following spin.

tiers.title: Win tiers and multiplier callouts
tiers.text: If the round total is 10 times the base bet or more, a celebration screen opens and the counter climbs through the tiers: {big} ≥10×, {mega} ≥25×, {super} ≥50×, {epic} ≥100×; a round that reaches the cap ends with {max}. When the hub passes the ×10, ×25, ×50 and ×100 thresholds it is announced with large lettering and its own sound. A free-spin round always ends with the “Elephant Clock — Total” screen. Tapping the screen brings the counter straight to the result; it does not change the payout.

ante.title: Chance ×2 · cost {cost}
ante.text: When on, every spin costs {factor} times the bet and Water Vessels appear more often in the base game: the free-spin chance is about double ({ante} / {standard}). Wins are still paid on the base bet. The bonus cannot be bought while it is on.

buy.title: Buy bonus · price {price}
buy.text: For 100 times the bet, at the end of the base spin the board holds at least {vessels} Water Vessels (if some are missing, slices that are not part of a win turn into vessels); {spins} free spins are guaranteed. It is done through a confirmation window, runs at a separate RTP ({rtp}) and cannot be used with autoplay.

rtp.title: Theoretical return (RTP)
rtp.caption: Theoretical return per mode
rtp.text: A separate {millions}-million-round simulation for each mode (engine cezeri-gears-1). RTP is computed on the cost paid. Win frequency (base spin): standard {hitStandard}, Chance ×2 {hitAnte}. Volatility (standard deviation in units of cost): standard {sdStandard}, purchase {sdBuy}.
rtp.note: The simulation is an estimate and is uncertified; because of the heavy tail the confidence interval may be optimistic. Results in a short session can differ greatly from the RTP. DEMO credit is worthless.

limits.title: Bet and win limits
limits.maxValue: {multiplier} times the bet · {amount} at this bet
limits.text1: A round that reaches the maximum win ends immediately; the remaining free spins are not played. The payout is always computed on the base bet and anything below a cent is rounded down.
limits.text2: Steps and modes your balance cannot cover cannot be selected. A round is a single reservation and a single payout; only one round is played at a time.

keys.heading: Keyboard
keys.spaceText: Starts the spin (Settings → “{option}”). It does not skip the spin during a round; it only speeds up the free-spin screens and the celebration counter.
keys.escText: Closes the open window (except the session reminder).
keys.tabText: Moves between the controls; focus is always visible.
keys.arrowsText: Changes the page in this info window; changes the option in settings choices.
keys.note: The screen reader announces every step (“Spoke 4: 3 Elephant Clock, hub ×3”, locks, the hub multiplier, the round result); the board is read as 4 rings × 12 slices. Symbols are told apart by shape as well as colour. The reduce-motion preference places the turning rings instantly and turns off particles and shake.

fault.title: Malfunction clause
fault.p1: A malfunction voids all affected games and payouts. In case of a software, browser or device failure the round record prevails; an amount shown on screen that does not match the engine record is not valid.
fault.p2: This game is played with DEMO credit only. DEMO is worthless and cannot be converted into money or tokens; in the event of a malfunction the DEMO balance and session history may be corrected or reset.
fault.p3: Because the result is determined before the spin, an animation cut short, a hidden tab or leaving the page does not change it; the round still closes once with the engine's payout.

history.emptyText: The mode, bet, cost, win and round ID of every round are recorded; you can watch any round again.

intro.text: The hub multiplier is not reset; it only rises from spin to spin. The water reservoir fills every 3 spins and the automaton falcon drops permanent Golden Gear wilds. 2 Water Vessels add +4 spins.

rules.board: The board is a hub with 4 concentric rings of 12 slices around it. On each of the 12 spokes running from the hub outward, 3 or 4 consecutive slices of the same symbol, from the inside out (starting at ring 1 or ring 2), pay; the Golden Gear wild stands in for every symbol. The hub multiplier (×1–×10) multiplies all spoke wins of that spin.
rules.features: Gear Lock: if there is a new win, the winning slices lock, the four rings spin again beneath them, and the hub rises by +1 with every respin; up to 10 respins, until no new pay arrives. 3 or more Water Vessels trigger 10 free spins (Elephant Clock): the hub multiplier is kept between spins and only rises, and every 3 spins the automaton falcon drops permanent Golden Gear wilds. The maximum win is 10,000 times the bet.
rules.fixed: The result is determined locally in your browser with local randomness before the spin starts; the animation only plays that result. Even if you leave the page, the round closes with the determined payout. There is no VRF proof.
